title: ue, ie and ey Teams
rule: The letters ue, ie and ey are vowel teams. ue and ie usually say long u and long i, like glue and pie. ey at the end often says long e, like key. Underline both letters. You can also put a macron on the first vowel and slash the second.
trickText: Find the two letters that work together. Underline both. ue says long u. ie says long i. ey says long e.
say: Today's case: three more vowel teams. ue, like in glue. ie, like in pie. And ey, like in key. Two letters, one sound.

activities.instruction: Code each word. Underline the vowel team.

example.say: Look at glue. The u and e are a team. They say long u. I put a macron on the u, slash the e, and underline both letters.
